projectDescription: A schema-first ORM for the JVM that generates a type-safe Kotlin/Java client and declarative migrations from a single schema file.
keyFeatures: Schema-first: define your data model once in schema.volan and derive everything from it
Build-time code generation: type-safe Kotlin and Java query DSLs, no runtime reflection
Declarative migrations: generated by diffing the schema against the live database
First-class Java API: no Kotlin-only types, CompletableFuture async, JSpecify nullability
N+1-free relation loading: one batched statement per relation level, not per row
Rust-style diagnostics: code frames with carets and suggested fixes for schema errors
Pluggable dialects via ServiceLoader: PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, H2
Aggregation and group-by: count, sum, average, min, max with type-safe result classes
Nested writes: create, connect, and connectOrCreate across relations in one transaction
Transactions with isolation levels and savepoint-based nesting
publicApiSurface: Volan.Builder: url(), username(), password(), maxPoolSize(), connectionTimeout(), dataSource(), dialect()
VolanClient: db.model.findMany {}, findFirst {}, findUnique {}, count {}, exists {}
VolanClient: db.model.create {}, createMany {}, update {}, updateMany {}, upsert {}, delete {}, deleteMany {}
QueryScope: where {}, orderBy {}, include {}, select {}, distinct {}, take, skip, cursor()
FilterScope: eq, notEq, gt, gte, lt, lte, between, oneOf, notOneOf, isNull, isNotNull, contains, startsWith, endsWith, ignoringCase()
WriteScope: CreateData, UpdateData, nested RelationWrite (create, connect, connectOrCreate)
AggregateScope: count(), sum {}, average {}, minimum {}, maximum {}
GroupScope: by {}, having {}, orderBy {}, take, skip
Transactions: Isolation enum (READ_COMMITTED, REPEATABLE_READ, SERIALIZABLE, …), RetryPolicy
Json.of(raw) / Json.NULL — JSON column value type
VolanException hierarchy: VolanNotFoundException, VolanUniqueConstraintException, VolanRelationNotLoadedException, VolanFieldNotSelectedException, VolanTransactionException, …
BOM: io.github.thirtyeighttwentysix:volan-bom for unified version management
